description: Delete one observation from the archive by obs_id (get ids from search_observations). Use to prune a wrong or stale observation. It is removed now; facets that rested only on it are retired at the next review, and nothing is re-read. The profile (facets) itself is not directly editable — observations are the input layer.

obs_id.description: the obs_id to delete (get ids from search_observations)

name: delete_observation
